description: Animate a still image (a MeltFlex render or any interior photo) into a short cinematic walkthrough video using Veo 3.1. Costs 100 MeltFlex credits for a 4-second clip or 150 for 8 seconds. Generation is asynchronous and can take 30–120 seconds. The MP4 is downloaded to disk and the file path is returned.

duration_seconds.description: Clip length: 4 (100 credits, default) or 8 (150 credits).

image.description: Source still image: a local file path, an http(s) URL, or a data:image/...;base64,... URL.

output_path.description: Where to save the .mp4. Defaults to ./meltflex-output/walkthrough-<timestamp>.mp4 in the current working directory.

prompt.description: Optional camera/mood direction, e.g. "Slow dolly forward, then pan left to the window". Defaults to a slow cinematic dolly.

name: generate_video
title: Generate interior walkthrough video
